mechanism: Piperacillin tazobactam may inactivate tobramycin in vitro and in vivo through beta-lactam mediated degradation of the aminoglycoside, reducing its efficacy.
action: Administer tobramycin at least 2 hours before or after piperacillin tazobactam; monitor renal function and tobramycin levels; ensure adequate dosing and spacing to maintain therapeutic levels.
